The Yelp page title reads 'BIERHAUS - CLOSED - Updated August 2026' while still printing a full weekly schedule (Mon Closed, Tue-Sat 11:30 am-9:00 pm, Sun 12:00 pm-9:00 pm), an own-site link bierha.us and phone (650) 395-8209. A German-lunch search can surface either venue; only 135 Castro St is open.
